nodes.label: ML Service Dependency Set
nodes.rationale: Deliberately small - every dependency is used and nothing is installed 'in case we need it later': fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic(+settings), pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, joblib, pytest, httpx.

nodes.label: Python 3.12 Pin
nodes.rationale: Not 3.14: the scientific stack's wheel availability on 3.14 was unverified at the time of writing, and debugging a source build is not a good use of a prototype's time.

nodes.label: xgboost / lightgbm Deliberately Not Installed
nodes.rationale: A gradient booster cannot extract signal the dataset does not contain; with 22 distinct feature vectors and 83% of rows sharing one it would memorise the 21 singletons and report a flattering in-sample R-squared that means nothing. scikit-learn's RandomForest already demonstrates that honestly at a fraction of the install weight.

nodes.label: shap Deliberately Not Installed
nodes.rationale: SHAP explains a model's contribution to its own output, so explaining a model that does not beat a median baseline would dress up noise as insight. The rule engine provides real, auditable explanations instead and is the primary signal by design.
